title: Nell and the Pond
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 4, 73-sound stage (nd, nt, nk just added).

pages.illustration: Nell the bee sitting on a reed low over a calm round pond.
A plain duck swimming on the surface of the pond below Nell.

pages.text: A fish swims under the top.
pages.illustration: A silver fish swimming just under the surface of the pond water.

pages.text: The duck can go on land.
pages.illustration: The duck waddling up out of the pond onto the grassy bank.

pages.text: The fish must swim in the pond.
pages.illustration: The fish swimming deeper in the pond water, well away from the bank.

pages.text: The pond is damp and cool.
pages.illustration: A wide view of the still pond in cool, shaded light.

pages.text: Plants rest at the end of the pond.
pages.illustration: Tall green pond plants growing still at the far end of the pond.
Small bugs landing on the green leaves of the pond plants.

pages.text: The pond is a good spot for fish and ducks.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering above the pond, looking down at a duck and a fish together.
